title: Harvest Bundle
subtitle: Shown locked until you have both wheat and an apple
text:
This page unlocks only when every condition in unlock_on.all is met: wheat and an apple. A plain list still unlocks when any one condition is met. You can nest an all group inside a list so any one group unlocks it, and { "any": [ ... ] } is the same as a list.

The default hint lists what is still missing, for example 'Find wheat, apple to unlock'.

steps.text: Both items are recorded the first time you have them. You can drop them afterwards.
